title: Business Combinations
intro: كل عمليات تجميع الأعمال تُحاسب بـ **طريقة الاستحواذ**.
الشهرة = المقابل المحوّل + الحصص غير المسيطرة − صافي الأصول القابلة للتحديد بالقيمة العادلة.
تكاليف الاستحواذ (أتعاب قانونية واستشارية) **مصروف**، والشهرة **لا تُستهلك** وتُختبر سنوياً.

tf.s: Contingent liabilities of the acquiree may be recognised if they are present obligations with a reliably measurable fair value.
Acquisition costs such as legal fees are added to goodwill.
Goodwill is amortised over 10 years under IFRS 3.
tf.why: It is tested for impairment annually instead.

tf.s: Identifiable assets and liabilities are measured at acquisition-date fair value.
A gain on a bargain purchase is recognised in profit or loss after reassessment.
Measurement period adjustments can be made up to three years after acquisition.
tf.why: The measurement period is at most one year.

fill.s: All business combinations use the ___ method.
NCI can be measured at fair value or at its share of net ___ assets.
The measurement period cannot exceed one ___.

source: Written for IFRS Play from the standard's core requirements. Exact source reference could not be verified from the uploaded document.
